description: Initializes a new package.json in the target directory. Works with npm, pnpm, and yarn. Returns structured output with the package name, version, and path.

license.description: Set the license field at init time (maps to --init-license)

module.description: Set default module entry point (maps to --init-module)

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

private.description: Set private: true in package.json (maps to yarn --private)

workspace.description: Create a workspace package (maps to npm --workspace)

yes.description: Use -y flag for non-interactive init with defaults (default: true)

name: init

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

packageName.description: The name field from the generated package.json

stderr.description: Standard error output — present on failure to explain why

version.description: The version field from the generated package.json

title: Init Package
